messages:
Elaine (AM): Heads up — got a 'whale' enterprise interested in a pilot that could hit ~4k RPS peak for a chat embed. They want a 4-week pilot then a potential monthly commit. Need a quick capacity sketch, price ballpark, and answers for their security questionnaire. Can SRE + SE pair on this?
Sam (SRE): Timeline? pilot start date and expected steady-state after ramp? Also do they need streaming responses?
Elaine (AM): Pilot starts in 2 weeks. Ramp plan: week 1 smoke -> week 2 ramp to spikes (4k), then steady 500-1k RPS after week 2. No streaming for initial POC.
Raj (SalesEng): Tagging Maria + Sam for sizing. Quick inputs from customer: avg prompt ~60 tokens, avg response ~160 tokens. Mostly chat embed, client-side dedupe, multi-region read.
Raj (SalesEng): Rough calc: 4k RPS * (60+160)=4k*220 = 880k tokens/s peak (~52.8M tokens/min).
Maria (Infra): For model choice assumptions: quantized 8-bit LLM throughput varies but safe baseline is ~220k tokens/s per GPU for production SLOs. That implies ~4 GPUs reserved to cover steady peak with headroom; autoscale to 8 for burst credit. Recommend a dedicated reserved pool + autoscale policy.
Sam (SRE): For 99p latency target <=300ms we need small batches and low queueing. Suggest queue_depth_guard 50ms, max_batch_tokens 4096. Also enable prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts to shave token compute.
Raj (SalesEng): From pricing POV: committed 4x A100-equivalent pool + burst credits to 8 for spikes. I'll draft a ballpark commit pricing and an add-on for autoscale burst.
Elaine (AM): Security asks: they require KMS-managed keys, VPC peering, and audit logs + >90 day retention for sensitive ops. Can Private or Dedicated satisfy for pilot?
Maria (Infra): Dedicated with VPC peering + customer-managed KMS works for pilot — no full private install needed. Audit logs can be shipped and retained as an add-on. We can provide an encrypted audit bundle for SOC review.
Sam (SRE): Operational fallback: if pool exhausted route to a compatible smaller quantized variant (lower latency, slightly different outputs) and turn on 'summary-only' fallback to stay within SLOs. Add circuit-breaker to avoid cascading latency.
Raj (SalesEng): I'll own questionnaire responses and include the fallback/rollover text and cost appendix. Elaine — please share security contact so legal can loop.
Elaine (AM): DM'ed Raj their security contact. Pinging ops-bot for a prewarm checklist so infra can prepare.
ops-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.runbooks/whale-deal-3925 — prewarm steps: 1) provision reserved pool 2) pre-create model shards 3) populate KV warmers 4) run smoke test (500 RPS, 10m).
Maria (Infra): Scheduling a config review: Thu 10am PT. Sam, can you join?
Sam (SRE): Added to my calendar. Quick snippet of the calc I used for capacity planning:
```
# rough capacity snip
RPS=4000
tokens_per_request=220
tokens_per_sec=RPS*tokens_per_request  # 880000
gpu_tokens_per_sec=220000  # safe per GPU (quantized, conservative)
required_gpus=ceil(tokens_per_sec/gpu_tokens_per_sec)  # ~4
# add 2x for headroom/spikes or autoscale to 8
```
Note: model family and sequence lengths change gpu_tokens_per_sec a lot, factor that into both pricing and runbook.
Elaine (AM): Action items: Raj — pricing sketch by EOD, Maria — provisioning options + security appendix by EOD tomorrow, Sam — autoscale runbook + SLO writeup before Thu config review. Thanks :thumbsup:
